# No Matter What Recovery

> > LGBTQ+-affirming addiction treatment center in Los Angeles offering trauma-informed care through PHP, IOP, and outpatient programs.

No Matter What Recovery specializes in substance use disorder treatment for queer, nonbinary, and LGBTQ+ individuals, integrating Minority Stress Theory, EMDR therapy, and dual diagnosis support. Founded by Mell McCracken and Eric Chaghouri, the center provides gender-affirming, culturally competent care in California.

## Key Topics

- LGBTQ+ addiction treatment
- Minority Stress Theory
- Gender-affirming care
- Trauma-informed therapy
- EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing)
- Dual diagnosis treatment
- Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Queer-affirming care
- Nonbinary treatment programs
- Substance use disorder
- HIV and substance abuse
- Los Angeles addiction services
- Residential vs outpatient treatment

## LGBTQ+ Treatment Programs

- [Partial Hospitalization Program Los Angeles](https://nomatterwhatrecovery.com/partial-hospitalization-program-los-angeles): PHP drug & alcohol treatment program in LA with dual diagnosis support
- [Support for Queer Individuals in Addiction Recovery](https://nomatterwhatrecovery.com/queer-addiction-treatment): LGBTQ+-affirming addiction treatment in LA with trauma-informed care
- [Nonbinary Addiction Treatment | No Matter What Recovery](https://nomatterwhatrecovery.com/nonbinary-addiction-treatment): Gender-affirming nonbinary addiction treatment with PHP/IOP in LA

## Treatment Resources & Guides

- [Inpatient vs Outpatient Drug Rehab | No Matter What Recovery](https://nomatterwhatrecovery.com/outpatient-rehab-los-angeles/inpatient-vs-outpatient-drug-rehab): Guide comparing inpatient vs outpatient rehab treatment options in LA
- [Quitting Drugs Cold Turkey | No Matter What Recovery](https://nomatterwhatrecovery.com/quitting-drugs-cold-turkey): Article on risks of stopping drugs abruptly without medical supervision

## Health & Recovery Education

- [HIV and Substance Abuse: A Closer Look at the Issues](https://nomatterwhatrecovery.com/closer-look-at-hiv-and-substance-abuse): Educational article on HIV/AIDS and substance abuse relationship
